channel.title: Scrum on Frederik
channel.description: Recent content in Scrum on Frederik

item.title: Week 35: Scrum
item.description: The Scrum framework: roles, events, artifacts, timeboxed sprints, Definition of Done and how Scrum supports iterative and incremental development.

item.title: Week 37: Scrum Project Kickoff
item.description: Kickoff of our Scrum project with Alpha Solutions: shared understanding, the first Product Backlog, Definition of Done, GitHub setup and the Sprint Zero debate.

item.title: Week 38: Sprint Review and Sprint Planning
item.description: Our first Sprint Review and Sprint Planning with the Product Owner: demoing the increment, adapting the Product Backlog and choosing the next Sprint Goal.

item.title: Week 39: Reflecting on Our Scrum Practice
item.description: Second Sprint Review and Planning, and a deeper look at how we work: retrospectives, velocity, the Scrum board, backlogs, pull requests, acceptance criteria and sprint goals.

item.title: Week 40: Quality Assurance and Testing
item.description: Quality assurance in a Scrum project: the test pyramid, test strategy, what to automate, test case design techniques, testability and quality as a continuous part of the sprint.
